div.font:
• LLMs can generate harmful content from benign prompts (hallucination, training data leakage)
• Adversarial prompts may bypass input scanning but trigger unsafe model behavior
• Output scanning protects end-users and downstream systems from model-generated risks
• Categories: Toxic language, PII/sensitive data in responses, malicious code/URLs, bias
